entries.en: Resume conversations from where you left off from with "claude --continue" and "claude --resume"
entries.zh: 使用 "claude --continue" 和 "claude --resume" 可从上次中断处继续对话

entries.en: Claude now has access to a Todo list that helps it stay on track and be more organized
entries.zh: 克劳德现在可以访问待办事项列表，这有助于保持正轨并更有条理
